    Twisting one arrow of a path realization by a unit #

    Let F₁ assign to each arrow a : i ⟶ j of a quiver a morphism F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i (the reversed realization). We twist one arrow a by a unit: on the target side (twistTgt, the morphism becomes W j ≫ F₁ a) or on the source side (twistSrc, it becomes F₁ a ≫ W i). If the unit commutes with the loop ℓ at that vertex and every other arrow at that vertex kills a (through any endomorphism), then a path vanishes after the twist exactly when it vanished before (pathMap_twistTgt_eq_zero_iff, pathMap_twistSrc_eq_zero_iff).
